design_brief_zh: 本章为连屏海报第1章，主卖点是TSA密码锁便于海关人员进行行李查验，故事从外部闭合与查验便利开始，下一章自然过渡至涤纶内衬。PC端1464×600采用居中标题与产品环绕标注：第0行标题置于顶部居中，第1行支持说明置于标题下方；第2行位于左侧，连接至开箱局部中的涤纶内衬和双区分隔；第3行位于右侧，连接至X型固定带。主产品置于画布中央偏下，采用三分之四正面角度，闭合箱体清晰展示TSA锁、铝合金框架、竖条纹表面和四角防护结构，并在旁侧加入小幅开箱细节，形成“外部查验—内部有序”的视觉逻辑。移动端1200×900保持标题→说明→细节1→细节2顺序：产品与旅行查验场景置于上方，四条文案置于底部两列，保留德语扩展空间。使用品牌蓝#01447B作为主色，橙色#E5641E仅强调锁具和引线，搭配低饱和中性色、自然侧光、柔和阴影；采用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体。YWJ Logo低调置于顶部或产品旁，但需人工确认实际Logo文件与位置；避免将护角视觉写成未经验证的耐冲击承诺。每条copy严格对应elements[].slot 0至3。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的TSA密码锁、便于海关人员查验、涤纶内衬、双区分隔和X型固定带事实；不得暗示海关认可、保证快速通关、绝对安全或任何未提供的认证、测试和性能。四角防护仅作可见结构展示，不写成耐用或抗撞保证。品牌Logo需确认素材后使用；不得加入竞品商标、价格、促销、虚构评分或未提供的规格。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ connected-poster hero image for YWJ 13 Travel Suitcase, chapter 1 of a continuous 10-panel story. Use a 1464x600 desktop composition and a mobile-safe 1200x900 adaptation. Center a closed hard-shell suitcase in a three-quarter front view, showing the TSA combination lock, aluminum-colored frame, vertical ribbed shell, corner protector structures, top handle, telescopic handle, and wheels. Add a refined secondary open-case detail showing polyester lining, two separate compartments, and X-shaped packing straps. Convey a realistic travel inspection context subtly in the background without showing identifiable officials or government branding. Use a pale neutral background, brand blue #01447B as the dominant graphic accent, restrained orange #E5641E around the lock and separator lines, natural side lighting, soft shadows, European modern travel photography, premium and trustworthy styling. Leave clear negative space at the top center for the headline and supporting line, and left/right callout zones around the product for detail labels; on mobile, reserve the lower section for four text lines in reading order. Include a discreet YWJ logo area only if the supplied logo asset is available. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, or watermarks in the image.
